introHtml: Enamel dog tags offer a durable, vibrant finish that stands up to daily wear, making them a popular choice for employee ID tags, pet identification, and event credentials. Unlike printed tags, the enamel filling resists fading and scratching, ensuring your logo or text stays sharp. Choose from soft or hard enamel to match your budget and design complexity. These tags are a reliable way to keep your brand visible on leashes, lanyards, or keychains.
heroAltText: Custom enamel dog tags in various colors with metal finish, perfect for branding and identification
